description: This PHP script handles the saving process of a 'ProjectTask' object within the SuiteCRM platform. It retrieves an existing task if a record ID is provided, updates its fields from POST/REQUEST data, enforces access control, saves the task, and then redirects or refreshes the page accordingly.
